def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    jacket_patches = image_patch.find("jacket")
    ground_patches = image_patch.find("ground")

    if not jacket_patches or not ground_patches:
        return image_patch

    jacket_patches.sort(key=lambda j: j.vertical_center)
    ground_patches.sort(key=lambda g: g.vertical_center)

    closest_jacket = jacket_patches[0]
    closest_ground = min(ground_patches, key=lambda g: abs(g.vertical_center - closest_jacket.vertical_center))

    if closest_jacket.vertical_center < closest_ground.vertical_center:
        return closest_jacket
    else:
        return closest_ground

    if not jacket_patches: return image_patch
    
    # Filter jackets that are on the ground
    ground_level = 0.5  # Assuming ground level is at 0.5 of the image height
    on_ground = [j for j in jacket_patches if j.compute_depth() <= ground_level]
    
    # If no jacket is on the ground, return the first jacket found
    if not on_ground: return jacket_patches[0]
    
    # Return the jacket closest to the camera among those on the ground
    on_ground.sort(key=lambda j: j.compute_depth())
    return on_ground[0]
